notes.subject: מעולל
notes.rationale: 'Bana ba dinku / sucklings' (YLT, JPS 'a babe') kgahlanong le 'bana/lesea' bjalo ka bahlokomedi (KJV 'children are their oppressors') — lentšu le ka bala mehla e mabeli.

notes.subject: מאשריך
notes.rationale: 'Bao ba go tloditšego mahlakore a mabotse' (blessers) kgahlanong le 'ba etelago pele' — ū-vav e ka ba copulative goba directive.

notes.subject: Setšhaba sa ka
notes.rationale: Bolelo go setšhaba sa Yehuda ka go raša — 'bajo ba go', 'ditsela tša gago'.

notes.subject: דרך ארחתיך
notes.rationale: Tsela ya ditsela — go boelediša mantšu a mabedi a bolela tsela, se sa phedišwa ka botlalo ka Sepedi.

translation: Setšhaba sa ka — bao ba se hlokomelago ke bana ba dinku, gomme basadi ba se laola. Setšhaba sa ka — bao ba go tloditšego mahlakore a mabotse ba go tsamaisa ka tsela e fošagetšego, gomme tsela ya ditsela tša gago ba e ngeditše.
